name: [GREEN ALIEN] Boboiboy Battlegrounds
desc:
Inspired by the show BoBoiBoy and other battleground games.
we all love boboiboy

Currently supports: Mobile📱, PC🖥️ and CONSOLE 🎮

🖥️ Controls:
Left Click: Punch
W + W: Sprint (or enable via settings)
F: Block
Q: Dash
G: Ultimate/Awaken (or click the Awakening Bar)
B: Emote

NOTE: This game is still in early development, so expect bugs and changes over time.
